regions.breakdown: 所沢 (Tokorozawa - place name), 駅 (eki - station), 西口 (nishiguchi - west exit), 通り (dori - street)

where_youd_see_it: On a street sign near Tokorozawa Station in Japan.
cultural_note: Japanese street names often incorporate nearby landmarks like train station names and directions (e.g., west exit) to help with navigation. The English romanization is often provided directly on the sign.
